title: Raise-Ask Expected Value Calculator
description: Compute the probability-weighted expected value of asking for a salary raise — including EV of asking vs. silence, recommended anchor, partial-grant scenario, and scripted ask framework.

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_raise_ask_ev
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model the probability-weighted payoff of asking for a salary raise. Returns expected annual value, lifetime EV over a merit-compounding horizon, silence cost, and recommended ask anchor.

targetAsk.description: Target salary to reach (not the raise amount)

pNone.description: Probability of no change (0-100); pFull+pPartial+pNone must equal 100

partialFracPct.description: If partial grant, what % of the full raise is received (default 50)

meritPct.description: Annual merit increase % applied each year (default 3.0)
